name: Wall Soleus Stretch

rehabilitation.clinical_protocol: Cornell Health Lower Extremity ROM Protocol

steps: Stand facing a wall with hands resting flat against the wall for support.
Step your target leg back slightly, about 6 to 12 inches behind your front foot.
Unlike the standard calf stretch, bend both knees and sink your hips straight downward toward the floor.
Keep your back heel pressed down on the floor as you bend your back knee deeper.
Feel a deep, focused stretch in the lower portion of your calf and Achilles tendon, holding for 20 to 30 seconds.
coaching_cues: Bending the knee takes tension off the gastrocnemius to isolate the deeper soleus muscle.
Keep your weight distributed evenly and do not let your back heel lift.
Breathe comfortably and allow the lower calf to release.

sources.attribution: Cornell Health Lower Extremity Range of Motion Protocol
